Medical debt is a pervasive issue in the United States, with millions of Americans facing financial hardship due to high healthcare costs.

In fact, [66.5 percent](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.NV3IV8RXB3BPG-RgoenRihEIGbYnHgis43qbcIGr7vpTEU9dabw5BNI5njgzTTl0YumQ-c2prRn5prOYblGhuf8AXZee8hXuYA78oQK-Gd54YZ2lQ_4sh__ZVkr3XzZskAWrgmsJaL9ZHSFjvFD2vNd5TpHXgUmrXVPFiGM887w3vJTRl8McIZgKgq_E0MLK5qsH0L5yhIkMCZruALIagVfCol-UgA9_qGz1CuAY4l7FmgNWcuQ7v3ywDgaLRy2pW1LOhpLvtN0--UpMgAm6-JPWdhYpr_3ezOioPq92I6nYSx8J1YVO6kiTxk7m__eqdfke-xO2costSzeL8l-rKMTfeadyF0yZ9w86WScFI_fEH9qdgcbqRucwgF3JNtOyzWA4nzLW9ypKSJU5wOeOx3zqaECXhPX-XfxnMipo06HL-eI2q8QP4njlyK1-eqJ9d0pd-2f5niRhi-DOKZiwFQ/46i/OLrrNA19Q9K1b2xbWasyLA/h3/h001.0_RL0rQXu-qgwFjMdN0eC_6F1cDlxaB4i_Eo1U6Xz0k) of bankruptcies are due to medical debt.

# Project 2025 Wants to Attack Nato
---
| [ ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/maga-os?refcode=2025)
---
**Every treaty that is holding up the Western World is at risk if MAGA wins in 2024.** We face a grave threat from Project 2025—Trump wants to cut America off from the rest of the world.🚨 One of the most alarming aspects of Project 2025 is its advocacy for the termination of crucial treaties like NATO and the complete closure of borders. Such actions not only undermine the collaborative efforts of nations but also jeopardize the very foundation of global diplomacy. As explicitly stated in Project 2025: **"international organizations and agreements that erode our Constitution, rule of law, or popular sovereignty should not be reformed: They should be abandoned."** Do no let their phrasing get it twisted... MAGA is attacking vital treaties for America and our allies. They might claim there is "erosion of our Constitution," but this is all a red herring to mislead the public while they tear apart vital foreign policy. Furthermore, by prioritizing the closure of borders without addressing the complexities of immigration, Project 2025 demonstrates a callous disregard for human rights and global relations. This compounded with the attempt to abandon longstanding treaties like NATO poses a real risk to our allies and destabilizes the security landscape that has been carefully constructed over the past century. It is imperative that we stand together to oppose such shortsighted and reckless actions that threaten the stability and prosperity of our world. I urge you to join me in raising awareness about the dangers of Project 2025 and advocating for policies that promote cooperation, inclusivity, and peace on the global stage. Thank you for your attention to this critical issue. Together, we can work towards a future where collaboration and understanding prevail. [**Join us in this critical battle to protect our nation from Trump’s authoritarian ambitions. Together, we can preserve the very essence of American democracy. Time is of the essence—your immediate action is crucial.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/maga-os?refcode=2025)

body:
With the primary election coming up in six weeks, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on the path we've traveled since I launched this campaign and the challenges and opportunities that lie ahead.
__ | | | [](http://links.padoraforcongress.com/u/click?_t=1632d2fd715245289db23a5b99e588cb&_m=f50b7bcdf7c34e08b26e509f8f9a6b70&_e=Vtc1ArAGsiHkeQr8OAiOMFBHMcdh08IAX3R2Dmh8ijQmjMyulqcZhDVUepzM1Bh9kyL8AhlFETiJTmrRLLDc-hpwwnGIepqxECg1vbwTAnDsKfEB_AYjAw6JksDyTkv4Gp9PLNZ9CDfWmUmD8N4gHcY3yU7dKhqwuxVcIJgaikNG05dxdc9HwuXjApV46NNntqgGBjuIaKZiV_alWjOQXCFaMUklpgX1uwrJ7QHTK9--q-zVV5895trrSnOqCljCEuw-Q67v_S_PtrwnvhyEF9Mxjk5wRD6SRtreZMAzyWRS-lO7DT-9LDQjBTKskfrmojrBYmFQ-6eJEaQ_U4R7NIh_ouTGa5OUwYoCc2KkrR6px9S9a2RsbxEcjp1eR4yfBAlxRKww2DALgYak1qE2uw%3D%3D) My friends, With the primary election coming up in six weeks, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on the path we've traveled since I launched this campaign and the challenges and opportunities that lie ahead. As I’ve told you many times, my story is not unique. I witnessed firsthand the neglect of working families by both major political parties. | | Dear Freedom Fighters,

This past week the Senate was in session for one day to try to vote on the [HCR 2060](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3fe5bfa213&e=a7ab36849c) dealing with Biden’s Border crisis. Two Republican State Senators proclaimed they were off the bill until it was amended. We also had a member absent for this important bill. We shall return this week with an amendment or two to pass this bill, so the voters have a chance to vote on it come November.

Newly released [data](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6196eb6aca&e=a7ab36849c) shows U.S. Customs and Border Protection recorded 1.6 million known "gotaways" from 2021-2023 under the Biden Administration. The majority of "gotaways" are entering our country through Arizona's border. HCR 2060, the Secure the Border Act will be voted on hopefully this week and then sent over to the House before being sent to the November ballot for voters to decide.

On Wednesday morning I had the honor of starting my day at Grand Canyon University, attending the 10th annual Police and Fire Prayer Breakfast. I am so very thankful for those men and women who protect our public safety across our state each day.

On Thursday morning, my bill to ban foreign donations in Arizona elections was revived since the Arizona House Chair on the Committee on Elections refused to give this bill a hearing earlier this session. I look forward to giving Arizona voters a voice. This bill passed overwhelmingly with Louisiana voters last election. Arizona should be next! [HCR 2056](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=84f5939496&e=a7ab36849c) will be sent to the voters in November. In addition to banning foreign monies in Arizona's elections, if passed it will also help speed up tabulating ballots. Some of the additional provisions included in this bill are modeled after Florida's election laws that post-election results on election night, not weeks later.

I also participated in a roundtable discussion on Thursday sponsored by the [Arouet Foundation](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=86e059baec&e=a7ab36849c) related to second chances. I have had three criminal justice reform bills signed into law this legislative session, including [Senate Bill 1364](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=428e2895d7&e=a7ab36849c), [Senate Bill 1367](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=f392659078&e=a7ab36849c), and [Senate Bill 1629.](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=ae37aa0874&e=a7ab36849c) _AZ Free News_ did a quick write up on SB 1367 and you can read it [here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=a6f369426d&e=a7ab36849c).

Arouet has been influential in helping to untap potential for women emerging from our prison system. This roundtable was sponsored in part by JP Morgan Chase, Banner, Mercy Care, and Southwest Gas. Arouet will be hosting an employment fair this fall. If you are a business that would like to participate you can reach out to Arouet and let them know I suggested you contact them.

Have a great week!

Take care,
Shawnna

**May 19, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Readers,
In this week's new episode of [Unleashed with Heidi Ganahl](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), we confront Denver's worsening homelessness crisis head-on. Despite a staggering $274 million investment from 2021 to 2024, the situation has only deteriorated, sparking outrage and demanding accountability. This funding has largely been channeled into emergency shelter beds and temporary transition services, strategies that have proven insufficient in addressing the complexities of homelessness. As a result, Denver has seen the largest increase in homeless populations compared to other metro areas since 2018, indicating that these efforts have fallen short of their goals.

This episode will not shy away from the controversy. Joining us is [Vanessa from Citizens for a Safe and Clean Denver](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to discuss the entrenched challenges and viable solutions, we'll also take you on [a tour of Springs Rescue Mission in El Paso County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), one of few success stories in this space. We delve deep into what some are calling the "homeless industrial complex," where the business of homelessness appears more profitable than solving it. Take the Colorado Coalition for the Homeless, whose CEO reportedly earns $380,000 annually, and also one of the largest landowners in Denver.

A large portion of the allocated funds went to major providers like the Salvation Army, which, despite receiving $12.7 million in 2023, achieved only a 17% success rate in securing permanent housing for its clients. Other organizations, such as the Denver Rescue Mission and Catholic Charities, reported even lower success rates, highlighting a systemic failure to provide stable, long-term solutions for the homeless. The question arises: Why are these nonprofits, flush with cash and resources, failing to produce better outcomes?
Today's episode is a call to action. Join the movement with [Citizens for a Safe & Clean Denver](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), an all-volunteer, bipartisan organization that's keeping the public informed and engaged with the issues that matter most. Or reach out to [STEP Denver](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Springs Rescue Mission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to support their success. Learn how you can get involved by following them on social media or signing up for their newsletters.
Together, we can push for our cities to prioritize safety, cleanliness, and effective solutions to homelessness. It's time for a change, and it starts with being informed and demanding better from those in power.
**> > [LISTEN TO THE FULL EPISODE HERE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) <<**
- Heidi Ganahl

clean_body: Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans. | | | | May 19, 2024 SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST By Heidi Ganahl | | Dear Readers, In this week's new episode of , we confront Denver's worsening homelessness crisis head-on. Despite a staggering $274 million investment from 2021 to 2024, the situation has only deteriorated, sparking outrage and demanding accountability. This funding has largely been channeled into emergency shelter beds and temporary transition services, strategies that have proven insufficient in addressing the complexities of homelessness. As a result, Denver has seen the largest increase in homeless populations compared to other metro areas since 2018, indicating that these efforts have fallen short of their goals. This episode will not shy away from the controversy. Joining us is to discuss the entrenched challenges and viable solutions, we'll also take you on , one of few success stories in this space. We delve deep into what some are calling the "homeless industrial complex," where the business of homelessness appears more profitable than solving it. Take the Colorado Coalition for the Homeless, whose CEO reportedly earns $380,000 annually, and also one of the largest landowners in Denver. A large portion of the allocated funds went to major providers like the Salvation Army, which, despite receiving $12.7 million in 2023, achieved only a 17% success rate in securing permanent housing for its clients. Other organizations, such as the Denver Rescue Mission and Catholic Charities, reported even lower success rates, highlighting a systemic failure to provide stable, long-term solutions for the homeless. The question arises: Why are these nonprofits, flush with cash and resources, failing to produce better outcomes? Today's episode is a call to action. Join the movement with , an all-volunteer, bipartisan organization that's keeping the public informed and engaged with the issues that matter most. Or reach out to or to support their success. Learn how you can get involved by following them on social media or signing up for their newsletters. Together, we can push for our cities to prioritize safety, cleanliness, and effective solutions to homelessness. It's time for a change, and it starts with being informed and demanding better from those in power. > << - Heidi Ganahl | | | STATE Three percent of all state legislators graded an A and 87% of legislators had a failing grade in the Liberty Scorecard Colorado ratings released Friday following the close of the 74th General Assembly. Gov. Jared Polis' office announced late Friday evening that the governor has rejected six bills, including measures that deal with employee discipline, construction wages and the treatment of energy derived from burning solid waste. Colorado ranked as one of the "most dangerous" states in the U.S. in a new report and it's mostly because of a high rate of property crime. | NATIONAL Republican presidential candidate Donald Trump has recently signaled an about face on the digital assets industry, promising to support crypto in the U.S. during a recent campaign event and offering a stark contrast to apparent hostility from the Biden administration. With colleges becoming hotbeds for antisemitism and pro-Hamas propaganda, comedian and actor Zach Sage decided to play a little game with the future minds of tomorrow. He introduced "Gaza Graduation: The Game Show" to these kids, asking simple questions about Hamas, Israel, and the Middle East. It was a trainwreck. The sweeping Trump-era tax cuts in the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 are set to expire next year, setting up the tax debate as a potentially key political issue this election year. The illicit fentanyl coming from Mexican cartels is becoming more dangerous, according to the Drug Enforcement Administration. | LOCAL The Douglas County board of commissioners voted Tuesday to opt out of a new state law prohibiting individuals from carrying firearms in sensitive places, such as government buildings, schools and polling locations. A legal battle between the Monument mayor and a private attorney has cost taxpayers tens of thousands of dollars and it's still not over. Top fire chiefs and administrators with the South Adams County Fire Department, along with some of their board members, have regularly taken their spouses along to winter conferences in Florida and fall conferences in Colorado's high country, billing taxpayers for their spouses' meals and other expenses, and extending their stays before and after conferences. ## Iran President Missing After Helicopter Crash
Iran launched a [massive rescue mission Sunday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL9uwyAQh5_GbI6OA4M9MHTJlq4dLQxHfBU2FkaJ-vaVO3f8_ZE-6ft6zA_Pmffnp9_ItVRmHxq_aB56hB71rEV0iQhJCXLSSoMwohnE6vRkYjIJRpLKSgmowSc7aSNjjNagYIdXOSDAOBglb3CddYrRSKMk-E4DRW6l3r4L722llH_Ki-otlE1kt7Z2nJ366PDe4d0fO73Pa7pCbRwydXjn6vd-pcyhHI1qXz2f3C96VIu3A2mlppAWSAQQrNJTBFTLKKqLx5tz5tPYTsNz85z_sO1fCb8BAAD__7rFW0k) after a helicopter carrying Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi and other Iranian officials crashed in the mountains during a heavy fog. Officials said darkness, rain, and muddy conditions made it difficult to reach the crash site. Raisi and the other passengers were returning from a ceremonial trip to the border to inaugurate a new dam. Raisi's condition remains unclear. Iran's vice president said two people from the flight had made [contact with the rescue team](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu7CAQAL8Gd7aWNXB2QfEad_falBaB5dgIg8Whs_L30aVOPdKMNB_3_e44c3n8dwfZHuvufOcX7XpEGFHtagg2EiHNA1l5kwZhQaOHZNdVOR9oXb2WNBttgnYo1ziDCYu-yYEtAirQCLBoM8sJIiykYghGmlmCEwoocK9t-qpceqKYv-uL2uTrMWSbej-fYv4ncBO4Xdc1-fLp31Dg9lYL3EAL3OQqcEuU2dezUxu5uTKejZ4cqPQxuRbG7Erg8phSP_LQbDgvzpmf5iYUPA7H-Tfa_1zwEwAA___-1VuX) and that the crash site had been identified. At least 40 rescue teams have been deployed, including drones and search dogs.
## Thieves Rob Celebrity Jeweler Harry Winston
Three robbers stole several million dollars worth of jewels in an armed heist at [Paris' Harry Winston store](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL_G7oiWNWAoKF6TLq-90sKwTjYixsIkOf_9KVdfOZpmNF-X6RI483r9Hx7k21KmEBu_aNICQaCaVJ_8QoQ09OTlKA2CRaP7m08ajY1x1kYSKpfIhBmSCqON0mpwPXsEVKARwGozyBMsYEktKRlpBgmhU0CJW6mne-G13WjJR3lRPcXy6LO_tbbt3fCvw3OH57Ct9N4_6gO1cczU4XkLlXdRyzxTPcRWMkcS-fn9rIe405vyLpYa1khiDLNLJLWyEIc4YzSOnDLRkdMYJPbVp-3NOfNuxk7B9RE4_6a0P8f8BAAA__9KEmO_), famed as "Jeweler to the Stars." The thieves used a motorbike as a battering ram to crash through the store, stole jewelry from several windows, and then took off on three motorcycles after firing a single rifle shot at police. Harry Winston's shop is famous for supplying high-end jewelry to celebrities attending glittering events. Eight people were convicted in 2015 in connection [with a dramatic 2008 holdup](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fu7CAQRb8GOiwYY8wrKF7jbtOmtMCM1xPhxQJ2nf37yKnTXeke6eh83uabp0SP-4ff0bU1z35p9MJ5ECAF6Fnz6FZEwJ6jU6MyIC2YgW8OMaK3_8bR61EHb0FZtIMKizUYdO85OZCg5QBS2sH0qpOrtKjXGI0yvZKeaYmRWi7dV6ZH23BN7_zC0i1558ltrR2V9f8ZTAym8zy7JdQHnvX6GUzXZDD5smMUJYeApYqNmkjP72d5i9pyQXH4QhfGi4vHSSlRNSPT8r57Sr-m9mf3TwAAAP__lLVaoQ) in which $92 million of jewels were stolen.
## U.K. 'Rich List': McCartney Now a Billionaire
Former Beatle Paul McCartney has become the first British musician [to become a billionaire,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71utDAQAJ_G7g6t1z9whYuvobuvTYmMWR8bGUzAOitvH13qdCONNNJ8PKZH4Mz783_YyNdUphArv2iyN4QbmsnIxSciJC3Jq145hAGdlau_E9qBAJOOMaGOBtNsrMNI7t4nsJI9AhqwCDBYp1UHCQYyaVmcclpBEAZo4VrO7rPwXldK-bu86Oxi2WT2a63HJfQ_gaPAsbXWzXN8O4HjTu0SOIazcsz0xvhld2v1oQZT5OmXo3HOfLleGHhugfNvtf75-BMAAP__609RMg) according to the Sunday Times "Rich List." The list of [wealthiest people in the U.K.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL3OozAQAJ_GdIvs5TcFxX0FXa69Ejl4DZsYG9lOEG9_IvXXzjSj-Xef7pod--Wv3mjINkx6zvyhqQGUgPVUF2awREhVQYPqVIuyx7Yp1kF21vRt01kjdX_D283KuUEprWrso9Gm4AEl1vJifdNWqpRW9lRbY1rVVkpqUUsynEMsn4F9Xsm6M3wolnPYCjesOe9JVH8EjgLH4zjKLfnLCRzJw_IQOG7B0ylwDHmlKHBMb2_0CZk3ShB5XsFxynCFwEqRQEeCvBIo-dWUMuwUdkfAHtIcstPeAPvZvQ37BZ4viOG4DgkcdYSfH7Wd-KqKOJj9YOc4tZ2o5bJpdt_w_OvG_wEAAP__3PJ0qA) revealed that the number of billionaires in Britain has declined from a peak of 177 in 2022 down to 165 this year, topped by British-Indian business executive Gopi Hinduja with the largest fortune in the list's history: $47 billion. Britain's prime minister, Rishi Sunak, [is wealthier than King Charles III](Former%20Beatle%20Paul%20McCartney%20has%20become%20the%20first%20British%20musician%20to%20become%20a%20billionaire,%20according%20to%20the%20Sunday%20Times%20“Rich%20List.”%20%20%20The%20list%20of%20wealthiest%20people%20in%20the%20U.K.%20revealed%20that%20the%20number%20of%20billionaires%20in%20Britain%20has%20declined%20from%20a%20peak%20of%20177%20in%202022%20down%20to%20165%20this%20year,%20topped%20by%20%20British-Indian%20business%20executive%20Gopi%20Hinduja%20with%20the%20largest%20fortune%20in%20the%20list’s%20history:%20$47%20billion.%20%20%20Britain’s%20prime%20minister,%20Rishi%20Sunak,%20with%20$826%20million,%20was%20wealthier%20than%20King%20Charles%20III,%20at%20$775%20million.%20J.K.%20Rowling,%20author%20of%20the%20“Harry%20Potter”%20series%20was%20said%20to%20be%20worth%20$1.2%20billion.), with $826 million. J.K. Rowling, author of the "Harry Potter" series, was said to be worth $1.2 billion.

name: Tom Barrett
subject: Barrett SITREP
body:
Open For Your Full Briefing | | | May 20, 2024
---
| |
---
Peter Willis,We are less than six months until the election and things are heating up. Lots of good news in this SITREP.We had our first joint candidate appearance with my possible opponent (I say possible because [Curtis Hertel screwed up his petition](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=664b50a89b7d6529e6a68f09&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.detroitnews.com%2Fstory%2Fnews%2Fpolitics%2F2024%2F04%2F30%2Fmichigan-house-congress-curtis-hertel-tom-barrett-adam-hollier-shri-thanedar-voter-signatures%2F73518056007%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_664762963c8dbd2e3950583b&l=en-US&s=n7EtM3PZ4QMTVU-mqitD1D33ELk%3D) to get on the ballot by listing the wrong office. The former chairman of the Board of Canvassers filed a complaint against Hertel and the Board will meet later this month to decide if he can remain on the ballot.) The Lansing Chamber of Commerce hosted a forum with nearly 200 people in attendance. It was a good snapshot of our very different views of the role of a Member of Congress and our priorities.On the heels of the forum, I received the endorsement of the [National Federation of Independent Business](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=664b50a89b7d6529e6a68f09&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nfib.com%2Fcontent%2Fnews%2Felections%2Fmichigan-small-businesses-endorse-tom-barrett-for-election-to-congress%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_664762963c8dbd2e3950583b&l=en-US&s=wZI6RtBulzFA1P3b51qR4WtrP_M%3D), the Voice of Small Business in America. I’m proud to have their support and look forward to working them and other small business leaders to help grow our economy and create good paying jobs for Michiganders.Our team is working hard and we appreciate all [your support](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=664b50a89b7d6529e6a68f09&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fmay-sitrep&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_664762963c8dbd2e3950583b&l=en-US&s=KFKqSkqf6t-UJmR0wIpJNy8XTB4%3D).
---
---
|
---
|
---
[_ _ DONATE _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=664b50a89b7d6529e6a68f09&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fmay-sitrep&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_664762963c8dbd2e3950583b&l=en-US&s=KFKqSkqf6t-UJmR0wIpJNy8XTB4%3D)
---
Former Detroit Police Chief and Republican candidate for Governor James Craig wrote an [op/ed published in the Detroit News](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=664b50a89b7d6529e6a68f09&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.detroitnews.com%2Fstory%2Fopinion%2F2024%2F05%2F13%2Fcraig-ensure-petition-signature-rules-are-applied-equally%2F73671665007%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_664762963c8dbd2e3950583b&l=en-US&s=cuSagn29vNJPnxyV5ySIrJ3YCeY%3D) this week urging the Board of Canvassers to comply with Michigan law and remove Curtis Hertel from the ballot for bungling the petition process.
---
| [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=664b50a89b7d6529e6a68f09&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.detroitnews.com%2Fstory%2Fopinion%2F2024%2F05%2F13%2Fcraig-ensure-petition-signature-rules-are-applied-equally%2F73671665007%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_664762963c8dbd2e3950583b&l=en-US&s=cuSagn29vNJPnxyV5ySIrJ3YCeY%3D)
---
| [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=664b50a89b7d6529e6a68f09&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.detroitnews.com%2Fstory%2Fopinion%2F2024%2F05%2F13%2Fcraig-ensure-petition-signature-rules-are-applied-equally%2F73671665007%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_664762963c8dbd2e3950583b&l=en-US&s=cuSagn29vNJPnxyV5ySIrJ3YCeY%3D)
---
_“My hope is that all candidates for any office requiring petition signatures are without flaws and submitted in accordance with the laws of our state. If not, there are consequences for those mistakes, and they should be applied equally across the board with no bias or favoritism. The Board of Canvassers should follow the rules and apply the laws as written.”_

name: Kevin Sorbo
subject: Hero Worship in The Fountainhead
body:
You probably didn’t expect this email from me.

*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* |
---
| | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6tp03ovv956lqcdd3ue42ud0bak548hivfqqi50_rp22sh2s8i6ep33c9i61p32c3h2bs) Friend,

You probably didn’t expect this email from me. It’s not about a new film or a political beef... but something deeper: philosophy and literature.

Like many of you, my wife Sam and I were deeply inspired by the novels of Ayn Rand, _The Fountainhead_ , and _Atlas Shrugged_. Sam identified with the character of Dagny Taggart fending off “moochers and looters,” while I connected with Howard Roark’s pursuit of artistic integrity.

It wasn’t until recently that I began to think of another one of Rand’s prophetic themes: her celebration of the masculine ideal — of strength, independence, and decisiveness as masculine virtues.

Yet today, masculinity is under attack — and has been for decades. No wonder so many boys and young men are feeling alienated, confused, and anxious.

First, we’re the butt of sitcom jokes. Eventually, the most masculine of us were considered “the bad guys.” Now, it seems like any form of masculinity is the "toxic" type.

>From the time these young men start attending school, they are lectured about their “male privilege” and inculcated with guilt as “oppressors,” even as they’re being marginalized and silenced themselves. What’s more, boys and girls alike are bombarded with messages in school and especially on social media about so-called “gender fluidity,” an ideological assault not just on masculinity and femininity but on the very concept of Objective Reality itself!

If young people could discover the literature of Ayn Rand — and her distinctly masculine heroes like John Galt and Howard Roark — perhaps they’d be inspired, as I was, to embrace masculinity and heroism and cultivate the personal virtues of reason, integrity, independence, and pride in achievement.

But here’s the rub: in the 1970s, 70% of young people were reading books every day for fun. Today, that percentage has plummeted to just 12%. How, then, to inspire young people to commit to reading a 1,000+ page novel?!

That’s where The Atlas Society comes in. Sam and I were introduced to the work of The Atlas Society by its CEO, Jennifer Grossman (JAG). We became friends with JAG when Sam and I lived in Southern California — I met her when I had to rescue her from a flat tire (talk about masculine virtue!). Joking aside, we were brought together by our shared admiration for the literature of Ayn Rand — and since then, have been actively involved with the organization: _with Sam emceeing their annual gala, appearing on panels, and joining in their weekly podcasts_.

What struck us about the approach of The Atlas Society was how they leverage art and technology to engage young people with Rand’s ideas — adapting her novels and screenplays into graphic novels, producing viral animated videos, hosting rollicking student conferences — that make philosophy fun and accessible.

**[I told Jennifer Anju Grossman (JAG), the CEO of The Atlas Society, that I would help them raise $30,000 this month. You can help them inspire young people to embrace their heroic nature by donating $10, $20, $50, or even $100 today.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z0o022d3aq8s12iis91te1j3e78pg1vlki62ml7g_rp22sh2s8i6ep33c9i61p32c3h2bs)**
[Donate](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z61pvlugt5j3kel2a8unlh03jdmti727mjrl78uo_rp22sh2s8i6ep33c9i61p32c3h2bs)
But I’ll tell you another reason Sam and I warmed to the work of The Atlas Society. It was an op-ed JAG published in The Wall Street Journal: “Can You Love God and Ayn Rand? As deeply devout Christians, we love Rand’s fierce defense of individualism and capitalism — but we part ways on the issue of faith. And for that reason, we appreciated the warm, and non-dogmatic attitude of The Atlas Society — welcoming religious and non-religious Ayn Rand fans alike.
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zapm4f55490tgn2mam59f7783ljo5grjo21e2qko_rp22sh2s8i6ep33c9i61p32c3h2bs)

name: Kevin Sorbo
subject: Hero Worship in The Fountainhead
body:
You probably didn’t expect this email from me.

*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* |
---
| | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2za0m9n8ehcv6v87kj1nhdl8qncn0mvcagcb3lh68_rp22sh2s8i6ep33c9i69o32c9h2bs) Friend,

You probably didn’t expect this email from me. It’s not about a new film or a political beef... but something deeper: philosophy and literature.

Like many of you, my wife Sam and I were deeply inspired by the novels of Ayn Rand, _The Fountainhead_ , and _Atlas Shrugged_. Sam identified with the character of Dagny Taggart fending off “moochers and looters,” while I connected with Howard Roark’s pursuit of artistic integrity.

It wasn’t until recently that I began to think of another one of Rand’s prophetic themes: her celebration of the masculine ideal — of strength, independence, and decisiveness as masculine virtues.

Yet today, masculinity is under attack — and has been for decades. No wonder so many boys and young men are feeling alienated, confused, and anxious.

First, we’re the butt of sitcom jokes. Eventually, the most masculine of us were considered “the bad guys.” Now, it seems like any form of masculinity is the "toxic" type.

>From the time these young men start attending school, they are lectured about their “male privilege” and inculcated with guilt as “oppressors,” even as they’re being marginalized and silenced themselves. What’s more, boys and girls alike are bombarded with messages in school and especially on social media about so-called “gender fluidity,” an ideological assault not just on masculinity and femininity but on the very concept of Objective Reality itself!

If young people could discover the literature of Ayn Rand — and her distinctly masculine heroes like John Galt and Howard Roark — perhaps they’d be inspired, as I was, to embrace masculinity and heroism and cultivate the personal virtues of reason, integrity, independence, and pride in achievement.

But here’s the rub: in the 1970s, 70% of young people were reading books every day for fun. Today, that percentage has plummeted to just 12%. How, then, to inspire young people to commit to reading a 1,000+ page novel?!

That’s where The Atlas Society comes in. Sam and I were introduced to the work of The Atlas Society by its CEO, Jennifer Grossman (JAG). We became friends with JAG when Sam and I lived in Southern California — I met her when I had to rescue her from a flat tire (talk about masculine virtue!). Joking aside, we were brought together by our shared admiration for the literature of Ayn Rand — and since then, have been actively involved with the organization: _with Sam emceeing their annual gala, appearing on panels, and joining in their weekly podcasts_.

What struck us about the approach of The Atlas Society was how they leverage art and technology to engage young people with Rand’s ideas — adapting her novels and screenplays into graphic novels, producing viral animated videos, hosting rollicking student conferences — that make philosophy fun and accessible.

**[I told Jennifer Anju Grossman (JAG), the CEO of The Atlas Society, that I would help them raise $30,000 this month. You can help them inspire young people to embrace their heroic nature by donating $10, $20, $50, or even $100 today.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zt0s1427tnfcdpc38n6bqfc87ni6052kb5s0de0g_rp22sh2s8i6ep33c9i69o32c9h2bs)**

But I’ll tell you another reason Sam and I warmed to the work of The Atlas Society. It was an op-ed JAG published in The Wall Street Journal: “Can You Love God and Ayn Rand? As deeply devout Christians, we love Rand’s fierce defense of individualism and capitalism — but we part ways on the issue of faith. And for that reason, we appreciated the warm, and non-dogmatic attitude of The Atlas Society — welcoming religious and non-religious Ayn Rand fans alike.

I really need your help.
Elise Stefanik has taken her show on the road, and is now [representing our country internationally](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/911a11f8-178c-4bad-81e1-4e02aac9de7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Moreover, she is denigrating President Joe Biden, and uplifting the name of the multiply indicted Insurrectionist in Chief.
My hunch: you're just as worried about this as I am.
How is this even permissible? She isn't the Secretary of State. She can't represent our country. My country. Me.
This time, she stepped WAY over the line.
As the Democratic Candidate running in opposition to Elise Stefanik, let me be clear: She HAS to go! The spread of Donald Trump and the MAGA mania stops here.
When I first read the headline that Stefanik was traveling to Israel to speak, I thought she was going to speak to the Israeli Parliament. Not true. Parliament is in recess right now. According to the NY Times, she spoke to the Knesset Caucus for Jewish and Pro-Israel Students on Campuses Around the World.
In the legal world, we would ask, "Couldn't this meeting have been an email?"
Couldn't this have been on Zoom?
Did she have to go above and beyond the Dudes Waiting for the Docket Call on Centre Street in Manhattan?
Why go? Why go now? What is the real reason for going at all? Is she now auditioning for the role of Secretary of State? Maybe. The [NYTimes ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0632680c-28c3-455a-8af2-b6a7af40fc74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)suggests that her remarks "appear intended to curry favor with Mr. Trump."
All I see is this: total disregard for protocols in international diplomacy.
Total disrespect for the sitting President.
Total dissociation with the Neo-Nazi, anti-Semitic tenor of Trump-speak in general, and [Stefanik replacement theory spewed as recently as May of 2022](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/593bd5e7-7601-4d53-99e3-f84788f72ea9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Congressman Jamie Raskin had [five yes or no questions for Stefanik](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/289ab814-6cd5-4a97-8a47-c2e8de770c5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in December 2023 after the first round of congressional interrogations of university presidents. From the Trump affiliation with Nick Fuentes (the known pro-Hitler revisionist) to the GOP's shrug over the antisemitic and race riot in Charlottesville, to Stefanik's 2016 endorsement of Donald Trump for president just days after he circulated an image of Hilary Clinton with the superimposed Star of David and a pile of cash, Raskin's inquiry boils down to this: **where is your moral clarity and ethical consistency, Elise Stefanik? **
The people of NY21 may be predominantly white, rural voters. Granted, there are a few J-6ers from NY21. But the overwhelming majority of the voters - even the conservative voters - have a moral compass that does not go to either of the extremes of Stefanik's Trump-directed political whims. In general, the voters of NY21 would neither march in the streets with Tiki torches to trample a young woman to death, nor would they light the fires of protest on an already incendiary bonfire of student protests. In general, the voters of NY21 - even the conservative voters - have a much greater tolerance for others than Stefanik has displayed on either end of the antisemitic question.
Without a doubt, the voters of NY21 would rather have their representative in the district, answering their questions and sharing their concerns, as opposed to hopping on a plane to Israel to try to impress Donald Trump.
People want to have access to their congressional representative to talk about their jobs, their mortgages, and their kids' schools. They want to express their concerns about the effects of climate change, and how that will impact our Adirondack ski industry, or our farms, or our very existence on the planet.
People of NY21 are terrified about the Dobbs decision, and what that might mean for the young women in their lives.
The people of NY21 are not really impressed that their representative would take time away from their needs to do cartwheels to curry favor with Trump.
Talk about this campaign. Talk about your concerns with your neighbors. Express your shock over the incumbent in this race.
**Shake off your Democratic despair and mobilize your efforts.**
We landed a man on the moon. Surely we can overcome an incumbent.
As for me -- I am in this race because I have to be.
I could not sit back and allow Stefanik to run unopposed.
I could not allow the theft of our democracy under the MAGA Project 2025 to go unchallenged.
Reading about the Elise express flight to Israel, I am more motivated than ever to get out, hussle the dollars, and shake the hands of voters.
I hope that I have your support.
If you are in NY21, I hope I have your vote.
Please, shake off your Democratic despair and join me.
[www.paulacollinsforcongress.com](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c099d95c-df7c-4ddf-92fd-ccdc3382c8e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

subject: These patriotic veterans are on the frontlines to save our democracy

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/HI%2BRES%2BTEMP%2BLOGO.png]
Peter,
I ran for Congress back in 2014 because I saw the consequences of failed leadership in
Washington when I served in Iraq—and I wanted to prevent that from happening again.
Now, my Serve America team is working overtime to elect a new generation of leaders with
proven service backgrounds—from the classroom to the Marine Corps. We’ve helped elect 32 members of Congress since 2018. When we had to flip the House to defend our country
from Donald Trump, our candidates made up more than half of the Democratic wins.
Since then, they’ve been on the frontlines of fighting the MAGA agenda and proving that
Democrats are the party of patriotism.
Click here to help elect more veterans and national-service Democrats by splitting a donation between Seth Moulton’s Serve America and the MassDems. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mass-dems?am=20.00&contactdata=+RwYatqAAY97zBRDqhErmAeb4zCDtlzm3Y8KMer2YlGAO5PrNlxrAG/uH8efaAFWiOs2Yp67h/G0h6VgmyvAOr36l7DyqmqMqvwFXRE9fE6n/0SikQQhj5oF5s/cR4zxrUle0NoNEDiS4FrqIFHhmnHwSz9I7gexDp+I1bDvI3s=]
In just the first few months of 2024, we’ve raised over $1.5 million for candidates around the [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/IMG_1335%2B%285%29-v1b.jpg]
country. Candidates like...
● Rep. Ruben Gallego, running a crucial Senate race in Arizona
● Rep. Jahana Hayes, in a Frontline race in the House
● Rep. Colin Allred, challenging Ted Cruz in what could be a huge November upset
● Rep. Jared Golden, whose rural Maine district voted for Trump in both 2016 and 2020
The 6th District used to be one that Democrats poured money into just to eke out a win. Since
2014, not only have we locked it down as solidly blue, we’re raising money and volunteers for
other tough Democratic races across the nation.
I’m committed to recruiting and supporting veteran candidates and expanding veteran
engagement within our party here at home, too. By passing my proposal to codify veteran add-on delegates into the MassDems charter, we’re giving veterans the seat at the table they’ve earned in our party.
Democrats should be the first choice for veterans looking to get involved in politics. It's past time we as Democrats take back patriotism from the extremists in the GOP.
That’s why I’m asking you to join me in my mission to elect more public-service
Democrats—from Capitol Hill to Beacon Hill—by splitting a donation between Serve America and the MassDems. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mass-dems]
Thank you in advance,
Seth

## SEX, MARRIAGE + DIVORCE According To Jesus
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5338.1.74463001a1eb2db76fc93a9c6623b3be)
---
What are grounds for a **biblical divorce**? This question has been hotly debated for 2000 years in the Church. **Jesus** says grounds for a biblical divorce = "_except for sexual immorality_." What does that mean? Is _abuse_ grounds for a biblical divorce? I address this and more in the series we are going through at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5339.1.d0922377aea7c2cbffd435c50726a5bf) over the[Gospel of Matthew](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5340.1.1c6495c47261fb24fda9c1b92fbb3fb0). I also address how to _prevent_ a marriage from ever reaching the place of grounds for a biblical divorce. Watch [Matthew Pt. 9 - SEX, MARRIAGE + DIVORCE](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5341.1.490c58790af3a6973d3639cc321df40a) here: [https://youtube.com/live/QBndJugRbTo](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5342.1.911c0b0e1b12fbd25159f629f4f27c91) Thank you,
Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer

## Special Guest Speaker Coming To Sheridan.Church
---
|
---
Over the last several years, we have been blessed at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5350.1.2db88e2fd6a53d978e799ea2d0aa65fc) with some tremendous guest speakers such as [Rabbi Jonathan Cahn](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5351.1.fd372cae19b4b66975e27b48854fcf3c), [Lara Trump](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5352.1.08f6c30436598bc34d162783211eae54), Perry Stone, [Darryl Strawberry](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5353.1.57fea3898038b54068c9fa66530969cd), [Mayor Rudy Giuliani](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5354.1.8840f625cf8310658f5b5facc2317d7b), [Roger Stone](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5355.1.0bf7ce5d9efdf19087195c76456bc108), Rodney Howard-Browne and so many others. In the future we have [General Flynn](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5356.1.1853d18bae250e279f3828c75a059af2), [Tim Tebow](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5357.1.ba7d043024e2db8e01ebcc185c8b1de1) and [Riley Gaines](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5358.1.70b329873c402f9f395f7817cf364f6c) coming to share. But one guest that I am super excited to share with you who is coming to [Sheridan](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5359.1.b86a031d604e9d9b1afb78074aa93a98) is a former professor of mine from **Oral Roberts University**. **Dr. John Swails** is the director of ORU's _Center for Israel and Middle East Studies_. **Dr. Swails** earned an A.B., M.A., and Ph.D. in history from the University of Georgia as well as an M.A. in near east studies from Brandeis University. He has been nominated as a _Who's Who_ among American Teachers for multiple years, I learned so much by sitting in many of **Dr. Swails** lectures that I know this service will bless you. Join me on **Wednesday, June 12 at 7pm** for a [LIVE Q&A w/Dr. John Swails](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5360.1.391f0c958980b58d79a5d1166a28ae77). **Address** : 7901 E 41st St Tulsa, OK 74145 For more information visit: [www.sheridan.church/events](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5361.1.c119aa75f9c3477c667b50179c9289db) Thank you,
Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer

I am super excited to share with you the release of a _new project_ I have been working on. 2 years ago, I did a _32 part series_ over the **Book of Revelation**. Since then, the Lord has shown me so much about **Revelation** that I did not know when I first taught the series and a TON has changed in our world since then. _Therefore_ , I sensed led to redo the series over the **Book of Revelation** with the new insights. This new teaching series will take each chapter of **Revelation** and break it down _verse-by-verse_. _"Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear it and take to heart what is written in it, because the time is near"_ **\- Revelation1:3** I know this teaching will bless you. I have also included the teaching notes for you to follow along. Watch Revelation 1 here: [https://youtu.be/VfS_4Aii2hE](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10778626.5363.1.be30f00128624ef49f001a53d1ccd1ed)

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...
* Consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America.
* Explore how the ideology of “woke capitalism” is infiltrating large corporations.
* Delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

All of our hard work in this election will come down to this moment, Peter. I’m the only Republican in this race who has what it takes to defeat Tim Kaine. | | Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update. We are __**15**__ __** DAYS**__ away from the June 4th Primary Election - EVERY. DAY. COUNTS! What is your plan to vote? Learn more about the three ways you can vote below, and make a plan to cast your ballot for Tom Kean, Jr. and the Republican Team ✅! This week, our field team was busy launching volunteers, hosting phone banks, and onboarding a fresh group of motivated volunteers! We had a record week of phone calls made by volunteers, breaking our standing 2024 record. Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to!
---
| | **Field Update**
---
| |
---
---
|
---
---
| | This past week, our field teams launched door knocking efforts in _**Raritan Township**_ , **_Raritan Borough_ ,** _**Readington**_ , _**Westfield**_ , _**Chester Borough**_ , _**Long Hill**_ , _**Mendham Borough, Warren Township,**_ _**Flemington**_ , and _**Phillipsburg**_. We are excited to expand our ground game further into Hunterdon and Warren Counties in the coming weeks. Kean for Congress held our weekly phone banks in Somerset, Hunterdon, and Morris counties. We reached out to voters who still had outstanding vote-by-mail ballots, as well as primary voters to discuss the importance of the June primary. As you know, a voter who votes in the primary is highly likely to also vote in November, and a strong showing will send a clear message that Republicans are ready to _send Tom back to Congress in November_! The phone banks last week resulted in an additional _**10,000 calls**_ made to voters ahead of the primary. We couldn't do it without our dedicated team of volunteers! **Call for Volunteers!!** The Kean for Congress team will have a significant Get out the Vote (GoTV) effort the weekend before Primary Day. We are seeking volunteers to assist with door knocking and phone banking to GoTV! Want to join us? Use the SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER button below and details will be provided. **Want to get involved? Join us at some of our upcoming weekly events!**

| | **Volunteer of the Week:****_Ruth Dilley_**
---
| |
---
| | __**Ruth Dilley**__ is a _**TOP**_ volunteer with the Kean for Congress campaign. Ruth hails from Readington Township and is a bright light on our team. Ruth is an active member in the Readington community, as well as her church. Ruth has been a top Hunterdon County Republican Committee volunteer for the past two years, and has volunteered to help elect common-sense Republicans for decades. Since our field program launch in April, Ruth has consistently shown up for our phone banks in both Somerset and Hunterdon - calling thousands of voters! Please thank Ruth for all her hard work - we are lucky to have her on the Kean for Congress team.

clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update. We are 15 DAYS away from the June 4th Primary Election - EVERY. DAY. COUNTS! What is your plan to vote? Learn more about the three ways you can vote below, and make a plan to cast your ballot for Tom Kean, Jr. and the Republican Team ✅! This week, our field team was busy launching volunteers, hosting phone banks, and onboarding a fresh group of motivated volunteers! We had a record week of phone calls made by volunteers, breaking our standing 2024 record. Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! | | Field Update | | | | | This past week, our field teams launched door knocking efforts in Raritan Township , Raritan Borough , Readington , Westfield , Chester Borough , Long Hill , Mendham Borough, Warren Township, Flemington , and Phillipsburg. We are excited to expand our ground game further into Hunterdon and Warren Counties in the coming weeks. Kean for Congress held our weekly phone banks in Somerset, Hunterdon, and Morris counties. We reached out to voters who still had outstanding vote-by-mail ballots, as well as primary voters to discuss the importance of the June primary. As you know, a voter who votes in the primary is highly likely to also vote in November, and a strong showing will send a clear message that Republicans are ready to send Tom back to Congress in November! The phone banks last week resulted in an additional 10,000 calls made to voters ahead of the primary. We couldn't do it without our dedicated team of volunteers! Call for Volunteers!! The Kean for Congress team will have a significant Get out the Vote (GoTV) effort the weekend before Primary Day. We are seeking volunteers to assist with door knocking and phone banking to GoTV! Want to join us? Use the SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER button below and details will be provided. Want to get involved? Join us at some of our upcoming weekly events! | | | | Volunteer of the Week:Ruth Dilley | | | | Ruth Dilley is a TOP volunteer with the Kean for Congress campaign. Ruth hails from Readington Township and is a bright light on our team. Ruth is an active member in the Readington community, as well as her church. Ruth has been a top Hunterdon County Republican Committee volunteer for the past two years, and has volunteered to help elect common-sense Republicans for decades. Since our field program launch in April, Ruth has consistently shown up for our phone banks in both Somerset and Hunterdon - calling thousands of voters! Please thank Ruth for all her hard work - we are lucky to have her on the Kean for Congress team. | | | | | Tom In The News | | | | | | | Voting Resources and Upcoming Dates Vote-by-Mail ballots have begun to hit mailboxes across NJ07 for the primary election. from Michael B. Moore

Welcome to our campaign newsletter.
We're happy you're here.
We're using this space to keep you updated on all the latest stories, events, and opportunities related to Michael's run for South Carolina's 1st Congressional District.
Stay tuned — we'll be in your inbox every Monday.
See you on the trail.
Join our movement [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
On the calendar
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Michael's cousin, Judge Harold Boulware, litigated the Briggs v. Elliott school segregation case in South Carolina, and he served on the legal team that won Brown v. Board of Education .
Last Friday, on the 70th anniversary of that landmark decision [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid0zhEG2qirJuXPKdYG9VkXtbvt9i4aMfYf6uZsqMsd1SEieAQvvjJSsj9obeG6ToMAl] , Michael recommitted himself to helping ensure equality and opportunity for all across the Lowcountry.
In the news
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Today, Scott Harriford — one of the smartest minds in South Carolina politics — endorsed our campaign for Congress!
Michael is happy to have earned his support in the race for SC-01.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Michael participated in a Lowcountry Liberal Ladies candidate forum covered by WCBD [https://www.counton2.com/news/your-local-election-hq/democrats-in-south-carolinas-1st-congressional-district-race-talk-abortion-term-limits-in-forum/] .
He believes this district deserves a leader who will defend women's reproductive freedom, invest in our children's education, and strengthen the economy for working families.
From the trail
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]

Federal authorities just exposed an American oil executive, Scott Sheffield, for colluding with our enemies overseas to steal from the American people -- and it likely cost you and your family thousands of dollars.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/718e44ba-76e8-4c27-b06f-ac6c96f1dca6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**The FTC uncovered hundreds of messages showing Sheffield conspiring with OPEC to artificially inflate gas prices. **
You know OPEC -- the Saudi-led Big Oil cartel made up of dictators and state sponsors of terror who generally all hate America.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/90d115e6-95ec-4e62-94b0-5b81a5c1ea72?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Sheffield's price-fixing scheme stole hundreds of billions of dollars from everyday Americans, potentially costing the average American consumer _$2,100 EXTRA DOLLARS_ at the pump during the height of the inflation crisis.
The conspiracy accounted for 27% of all inflation in 2021 alone.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dc852d0c-1089-4c01-a656-146e9e2aaf71?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**In the Marines, if one of us got caught colluding with our enemies to harm the American people, we 'd be thrown in jail.** We'd lose every dime we stole. And we could even be charged with treason.
**It shouldn 't be any different for an American oil tycoon. **But I'm sure it won't surprise you to learn, it is.
**Sheffield heads a powerful oil family that 's given huge sums of money to politicians in both parties. **
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5007e1c8-0576-4176-a634-4bd268ce68f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So, instead of getting sent to a jail cell like any of us, his fallout was collecting millions of dollars from Exxon in a golden parachute payout on the way out the door.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/28aacad5-ed41-4f8c-b18b-553d311d1f12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If our politicians want to prove their loyalty to the American people, you'll see headlines about them returning their donations from the Sheffield family.
**But the betrayal, the corruption, the lack of coverage -- none of that is the worst part of this story.**
It's that our politicians let it happen. And they've been letting it happen for decades.
Tens of trillions of dollars. The lives of thousands of American soldiers. Decades of war and nation-building abroad. Endless subsidies and tax breaks. That's what our politicians have been willing to spend on behalf of Big Oil.
But while American oil executives and the Saudi Royal Family have continued to rake in record-breaking profits year after year, the American people have gotten nothing in return but higher gas prices and broken campaign promises from every president this century.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c7dd1c49-94a1-40b8-ab1b-e2217d8fefcb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
American oil companies and OPEC have our country on its knees -- and it should be clear by now that even with more aggressive action by the FTC or the DoJ, we can't trust any president, from either party, to fix this.
**We need Congress to act.** We need rules that recognize the international oil industry is not a free market, but rather a cartel of foreign adversaries and multinational corporations who will never have an interest in providing products and services to the American people at a fair price. And we need new laws that compel American energy companies to finally put Americans first.
Here's a plan that can start to make that happen.
1. **We outlaw communication between American oil executives and OPEC, as well as any agent of a foreign oil company.** Nothing good can ever come of them getting together.

2. **We ban exports of American oil.** Sheffield himself led the lobbying campaign that got President Obama to sign off on ending America's 40-year ban on exporting our own oil. It's made America less safe. And it's let American oil tycoons like Sheffield jack up prices alongside OPEC's price fixing.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9c7ba7fa-104a-4d07-a823-ae96015aa9cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
3. **We ban any and all participation in politics by oil companies and the people who run them.** No lobbying. No campaign contributions. No PACs. Sheffield's price-fixing scheme with OPEC has proven that "American" oil companies are part of an international cartel that operates against the interests of the American people. Foreign interests should have no role in our politics or our elections.

4. **We need to empower the FTC and DoJ to more forcefully investigate Big Oil price-fixing.** And when wrong-doing by an oil company or its leaders is proven, regulators should be enabled to enforce a corporate restructuring that transitions the company to a new kind of for-profit corporate entity, modeled after benefit corporations, that would require the company to provide American consumers the lowest possible price for energy without excessive profit. And they'd be further obligated to pay taxpayers back every public dollar they've received in the past.

This country has given no other industry more of its blood, sweat, and treasure than it has to these oil tycoons. It's time they paid us back instead of knifing us in the back. So we can invest in an energy future that's led by American workers, not criminals and foreign dictators.

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: with a heavy heart
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Friend , it's with a heavy heart I’m reaching out to tell you that as of May 1, 2024, reproductive rights are effectively gone in Florida.
When the Florida Supreme Court upheld Ron DeSantis' already-unconstitutional 15-week ban last month, they gave the green light for his even worse six-week trigger ban to take effect.
Even when 1 in 3 people only find out they're pregnant after six weeks have already passed.
Even when there are almost no exceptions for rape and incest.
Even when 75% of Florida voters oppose such extreme measures.
We haven't even gone a full day under this law, but one day is too many. And I know I'm not the only one who thinks so: abortion is a winning issue, and we've seen it in every election, red state or blue, since Roe v. Wade was overturned.
So this is not the end of our fight for abortion rights. It's just the beginning.
We can save our pro-choice Senate majority and codify reproductive freedom nationwide, but it starts with kicking out extremists standing in the way, like Sen. Rick Scott. I'm fighting every day to defeat him, but I need your help to reach my emergency $100,000 goal and win. Will you split $15 between my campaign and Serve America before midnight tonight to help me flip Florida blue? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
Look, friend: This ban has ripped away my rights, the rights of my two daughters, and the rights of millions of women who will be put in danger across our state.
And just so we're clear: It's all because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and the Senators who allowed him to appoint the anti-abortion extremists who went on to reverse the protections of Roe.
Senators like Rick Scott, who proudly says that, were he still governor of Florida, he would've signed that extreme six-week ban.
He's been living in a bubble of far-right extremists. He refuses to accept that the tides are turning in Florida, or that everyday families simply do not support his toxic, anti-choice agenda. That's why I'm running to retire him.
If I make it to the Senate, I'll do everything I can to pass legislation that reinstates abortion rights nationwide. But my opponent is a mega-millionaire who can and will spend practically anything to bankroll his attack ads and drown us out.
I need your grassroots support today because without it, I simply won't make it to the Senate. So please, if you're with me in the fight for our freedoms and against extremist, out-of-touch politicians desperate to control us, will you rush $15 — split between my campaign and Serve America — before midnight to help me make reproductive rights the law of the land once more? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
Together, we will win.
Thank you,
Debbie

Trump’s Supreme Court — his appointed justices — struck down Roe v. Wade. His “leadership” in the pandemic led to more than a million deaths. And his conspiracies and election denial pushed our democracy to the brink on January 6th.
#

Peter, a quick note here from me.
I like to take a couple minutes to myself when I can, and reflect about why we’re doing this work. Today I was thinking back to what it felt like in 2016 when Trump won.

| Peter, In times of global economic uncertainty and expanding government influence, it's critical for every American to take command of their financial future. **This is why I'm inviting you to join me tomorrow, May 21st, at 8 PM Eastern for "The American Prosperity Blueprint," a live virtual event designed to empower you with the financial strategies typically reserved for the elite.**
[**Register now for your last chance to join!**](https://xtz223.keap-link005.com/v2/click/5d754dc5c55c61a58d9d13c9ce444eec/eJyNkE0LgkAQhv_LnCVzzYs3iQixOkSdY1mnGtJ1WcfMxP_e9oGngs7zvM_LOz0waqk5zSGGG9-FCMEDi4oMoeZ5pVmq11VEsyAMPChIX5a2agzE_dfwCLxSIhIecGfQIbttMs_SzfKwSjeZI420ruNPTzgdPYt1kq5gGH6KsSReXJ27hphtg89FOblVvLeF48_Mpo59v23bCRpSR3L1imRRs5WMJ8J6oqrSL2XnbNIY1PnnFRl2b-fwAEodaAI=) **Why This Event Is Crucial:** With today's economic volatility and government policies impacting personal finances more than ever, mastering self-reliance is not just a choice—it’s a necessity. Rob Gill, a seasoned financial strategist, and I will reveal the essential strategies for securing and enhancing your wealth, regardless of economic conditions. **Key Insights You’ll Gain:**
* **Proven Wealth Strategies:** Strategies that the financially successful use to safeguard and grow their assets.
* **Tax Mastery:** Effective methods to legally reduce your tax liabilities and increase your take-home earnings.
* **Legacy Planning:** Techniques to ensure your financial independence benefits future generations.

**Join Us and Take Action:** This session is more than an information exchange—it's a call to action for every forward-thinking American. Bring your enthusiasm and your questions. It’s time to take a proactive stance towards your financial independence. [Secure your free spot now—spaces are filling up!](https://xtz223.keap-link005.com/v2/click/2477d1ececead126a3838e00a74a022c/eJyNkE0LgkAQhv_LnCVT8-ItJEI0D1HnWNaphnRd1jEz8b-3fVCXgs7zvM_LOwMwKqE4KSCCC199PwAHDErShIrjWrGQj6sfzrzAc6AkdVqautUQDV_Db-CR8sOpA9xrtMhmPY_TJF_usiRPLamFsR1_eoKPZ7GaJxmM408xVsSLs3U3ELFp8b6oILuKt6a0_JFZN5Hrdl03QU1yT7ZekigbNoLxQNhMZF25leitTWiNqni9IsX-6RxvSG1oAA==) See you tomorrow, May 21st at 8 PM Eastern. Embrace this opportunity to fortify your financial security and assert your economic freedom. Best regards, Bill Spadea P.S. True patriots empower themselves and their communities. Don’t keep this to yourself—share this link with friends and family and let's strengthen our financial foundations together.

| Did you see this previous message from Bill? In case you missed it, check it out now: I wanted to share a touching story that recently unfolded, showcasing the incredible kindness and generosity that epitomizes the spirit of New Jersey. Last week, we received a call from Penny, a 71-year-old woman facing a challenging situation with her broken HVAC system. As she tearfully explained her predicament during a discussion about affordability in our state, something remarkable happened. Ryan, a service manager at First Choice Plumbing and Heating, listened to Penny's story and immediately offered a solution: a free HVAC system and installation. This act of kindness not only provided Penny with much-needed relief but also sparked a new friendship that warmed all our hearts.
When my wife Jodi and I visited Penny's home to witness the installation, we were deeply moved by the generosity extended by Ryan and his team. Not only did they donate the system and labor, but they also paid Penny's HOA fees for the entire year—an extraordinary gesture of compassion and solidarity. This moment reminded me once again why New Jersey is such a special place. When it comes to rallying around those in need, New Jerseyans stand out as the epitome of kindness and generosity. This is precisely what the Common Sense Club holds near and dear to its heart—making New Jersey a better place for all New Jerseyans. It's about extending a helping hand, fostering connections, and embodying the values of compassion and community. I invite you to watch the video of our meeting with Penny for the first time, and I hope it inspires you as much as it has inspired me. With gratitude, Bill

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/New%20Sewell%20Delegate%20Logo%20.png]
May 20th Newsletter
Dear neighbors,
Did you see the aurora borealis last week? Powerful magnetic storms meant some folks across the entire United States got the chance to see a special viewing of the Northern Lights. I heard rumors of folks seeing it over in Reston. I didn’t see it in Prince William, but let me know if you did! Besides unexpected astral events, there was another significant moment in Virginia this week - the May 13th Special Legislative Session. This session was called pursuant to a Proclamation from the Governor [https://www.governor.virginia.gov/newsroom/proclamations/proclamation-list/special-session-1.html#:~:text=I%2C%20Glenn%20Youngkin%2C%20Governor%20of,2024-2026%20biennial%20budget%20and] and provisions of House Joint Resolution 428 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+ful+HJ428ER] to reach a final compromise on the 2024-2026 biennial budget and avoid a government shutdown.
General Assembly Updates
As a member of the House Appropriations Committee, I was proud to vote in favor of our compromise budget (HB6001) which passed the General Assembly on Monday. This budget invests directly in working families. HB6001 will send millions of dollars directly to our schools as well as invest in access and improvements to public transportation, health care, housing, and veterans services.
These education investments include a 3% pay raise for teachers and school support staff and increases in direct aid to public schools (including $616 million each year for at-risk youth). Our investments span from birth to adulthood, with $527.8 million in funds for early childhood education (including 1,000+ new child care subsidy slots for low-income parents) and an additional $202 million for higher education (including direct financial aid to students and investments in HBCUs) in just the first year.
Beyond education, this budget provides $10.1 million to increase compensation rates for elderly and disabled Medicaid recipients in the Developmental Disability (DD) Waiver program, $60 million for WMATA, $87.5 million for the creation or preservation of affordable housing, and $9.68 million to invest in our veterans via the Virginia Military Survivors & Dependents Education Program (VMSDEP). Take a look at the graphics below for a summary of key investments in the bipartisan budget.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/Screenshot%202024-05-20%20at%209.46.15%20AM.png]
Del. Sewell's 2024 Budget Amendments
I was truly honored to stand with Democratic leaders in the House of Delegates and State Senate who came together with our Republican governor to pass this budget. In my first session as a member of the House Appropriations Committee, I was also uniquely positioned to advocate for necessary investments which ultimately made it into the final budget last Monday. Below is a brief summary of the budget amendments which I introduced during the legislative session that ultimately made it into the final biennial budget.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/Screenshot%202024-05-20%20at%209.45.48%20AM.png]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87444/images/Screenshot%202024-05-20%20at%209.46.02%20AM.png]
News You Can Use
Budget details revealed: No new tax increases, no additional tax relief, more than $2.5 billion in K-12 funding [https://cardinalnews.org/2024/05/13/youngkin-signs-bipartisan-state-budget-ending-budget-stalemate/] | Cardinal News
The General Assembly on Monday approved a budget compromise for fiscal years 2024-26, ending a stalemate between Gov. Glenn Youngkin and Democrats that began in early March, when the legislature adjourned its regular session.
State budget includes $50 million for broadband deployment [https://cardinalnews.org/2024/05/13/state-budget-includes-50-million-for-broadband-deployment/] | Cardinal News
Virginia’s recently passed law to speed broadband deployment to rural areas now has a financial component.
Virginia lawmakers pass bipartisan budget that leaves tax policy unchanged [https://virginiamercury.com/2024/05/13/virginia-lawmakers-pass-bipartisan-budget-that-leaves-tax-policy-unchanged/] | Virginia Mercury
After months of partisan combat over different priorities, Virginia lawmakers approved a bipartisan budget deal Monday with no major tax changes, funding boosts for education and mental health and salary increases for teachers and state employees.
Will Youngkin appoint a DEI director, as the state budget directs? [https://virginiamercury.com/2024/05/15/will-youngkin-appoint-a-dei-director-as-the-state-budget-directs/] | Virginia Mercury
After signing a new state spending plan on Monday, Virginia Gov. Glenn Youngkin must appoint a director for the Office of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion by July 1 or risk losing money for the office, whose title he renamed by replacing “equity” with “opportunity,” a move which Democrats criticized as contrary to state code.
Virginia lawmakers to study campus safety policies after series of protests [https://virginiamercury.com/2024/05/14/virginia-lawmakers-to-study-campus-safety-policies-after-series-of-protests/] | Virginia Mercury
The Virginia House of Delegates has formed a select committee on maintaining campus safety and allowing students to exercise their First Amendment rights, after more than 125 arrests at four of Virginia’s college campuses.
Community Events
May 20 | Speak Into Existence Open Mic [https://www.eventbrite.com/e/speak-into-existence-open-mic-tickets-882454233367?aff=ebdssbdestsearch]
Join haiku host Kim B Miller, for a poetry open mic night. Kim B Miller the first African American Poet Laureate for Prince William County, Manassas & Manassas Park, VA.
May 25 | Community Pools & Waterparks Open For Summer 2024 [https://www.pwcva.gov/events/community-pools-waterparks-open-today]
Prince William County has three outdoor community pools, plus Veterans Park Pool which is an outdoor community pool with a twisting waterslide. Visit https://www.pwcva.gov/pools [https://www.pwcva.gov/pools] for more information.
May 28 | #PWCPD EVENT: Community Watch Presentation [https://www.pwcva.gov/events/pwcpd-event-community-watch-presentation]
Learn how you can work with the Police Department to make your neighborhood safer. Hosted at the Potomac Community Library, 2201 Opitz Blvd., WOODBRIDGE - VA.
May 29 | Human Trafficking: Know Your Rights [https://www.pwcva.gov/events/human-trafficking-know-your-rights]
Join this free, virtual webinar on Human Trafficking hosted by the Prince William County Human Rights Office. You will learn about: EEOC, human trafficking and legal enforcement, youth human trafficking prevention, intervention and resources, and underlying causes of human trafficking from patterns of discrimination.
June 1 | Zumba Pride at Chinn Aquatics & Fitness Center [https://www.pwcva.gov/events/zumba-pride-chinn-aquatics-fitness-center]
Dance at Chinn Aquatics and Fitness Center in this celebration of pride and diversity. This event is FREE to passholders and a $12 group exercise drop-in rate applies for non-passholders.
June 5 | Addressing Food Insecurity Through Financial Empowerment [https://www.eventbrite.com/e/addressing-food-insecurity-through-financial-empowerment-tickets-904832086127?aff=ebdssbdestsearch]
Jamaur Law Foundation Inc and The Prince William County Community Foundation, Inc.’s “SMART MONEY" financial literacy program is designed to equip you with the tools and knowledge you need to take control of your finances and ensure your family has access to nutritious food.
June 8 | Fire & Rescue Life Safety Information & Education Pop Up [https://www.pwcva.gov/events/fire-rescue-life-safety-information-education-pop-1]
The Prince William County Fire & Rescue System is hosting Fire and Life Safety information and education pop up at West Gate Elementary School and will cover their Smoke Alarm Program, File of Life Program, when to call 911, and emergency preparedness.
June 19 | 4th Annual Greater PW Juneteenth Parade! [https://www.eventbrite.com/e/4th-annual-greater-pw-juneteenth-parade-tickets-888467087977?aff=ebdssbdestsearch]
Celebrate freedom and unity at this year's "4th Annual Greater PW Juneteenth Parade" held at the Prince William Forest Park!
State and Community Info & Resources
Virginia Cooperative Extension | This arm of our county government helps people put scientific knowledge to work through learning experiences that improve economic, environmental, and social well-being. Educational programs are designed to enable families to better manage resources, help youth become productive members of society, and improve the impact of urban horticulture on the environment. Learn more about the Prince William VCE at https://www.pwcva.gov/department/virginia-cooperative-extension [https://www.pwcva.gov/department/virginia-cooperative-extension] .
How to Get a Library Card | For those Prince William County and City of Manassas residents who do not yet have a library card, you can sign up for a digital library card or physical card. The digital library card allows access to the digital library without visiting a library branch. For a physical card, go to your nearest library branch and fill out a library card application. You’ll need proof of your current address which could be a lease with your name and street address or a driver’s license. Learn more here: https://www.pwcva.gov/department/library/get-library-card [https://www.pwcva.gov/department/library/get-library-card]
Veterans Benefits Support | The Virginia Department of Veterans Services advocates for Virginia veterans and connects them to benefits and services they have earned. Information on current federal, state and local veterans’ programs, entitlements and referral services is available in Virginia through a network of 35 benefit service offices. All services are provided free of charge. To view the DVS benefits brochure click here [https://www.dvs.virginia.gov/benefits#:~:text=benefits%20brochure%20click-,here,-.%20To%20View] . To view the DVS benefits video click here [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nWOkXyPzG5U&t=63s] .
Stay In Touch
Thanks again for reading our weekly update and staying in touch with our office. If there is anything we can help you with, don’t hesitate to call our office at 703-261-4787 or shoot us an email at DelBSewell@house.virginia.gov [DelBSewell@house.virginia.gov] .
In service,
Briana Sewell

Woodbridge, VA 22195
