body:
This is EXACTLY how close we are to turning TN blue.

| | | | | [ ](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fourtenn.org%2F/1/010f018f97d28026-ac71fa02-cf3f-496b-8df1-adad5fef5259-000000/RxbFxfQKhwGdKFZmqB9ywme8K5k=159)
---
Hello Peter,
---
| | Here are some interesting numbers for you:
* There are over 4.5 million registered voters in Tennessee;
* Less than half (about 40%) voted in the last general election;
* If we add 10% more Democrats to the voting totals - **we win.**

The truth is painful but clear: national strategies have largely abandoned Tennessee, leaving local campaigns to fend for themselves amidst an increasingly challenging political landscape dominated by MAGA agendas.

This neglect has real consequences. We've seen detrimental policies being enacted that threaten public education, healthcare, women’s reproductive rights, workers’ rights and Democracy. The MAGA Republicans feel so empowered and safe to do their extremist bidding, that they are even willing to kick out our elected leaders from the Capitol. Without adequate support and resources, our local Democratic voices struggle to be heard.

[Donate now and help us accomplish our three main priorities.](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Four-tennessee-future-pac-1%3Frefcode=TENN_24_EM_10_Abandoned/1/010f018f97d28026-ac71fa02-cf3f-496b-8df1-adad5fef5259-000000/Nsq9OVaMMSwjD1QfYPXBmlo30gs=159)

1. **Filling the Void:** By supporting our PAC, you’re stepping in where national parties have stepped back. Your contribution directly empowers local candidates and grassroots movements desperate for resources to make a substantial impact.
2. **Creating a Blueprint for Success:** Your support will help us build a sustainable model of local political success that doesn’t rely on fluctuating national interest. We are here for Tennessee, first and foremost.
3. **Championing True Representation:** We support candidates who embody the diversity and values of our communities. They understand the challenges and aspirations of their constituents because they live them every day.

---

Together, we can show that Tennessee is not forgotten. We are resilient, and with your help, we will demonstrate the power of dedicated, local political engagement.

In solidarity,
Chris Murdock
Our Tennessee Future PAC Team

| [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85314433/474362016/-1141683812?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkyOTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmNjMWM1ZTMtZWMxNi1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YO9O6Zs9dAqRJ6y-LSW2CHoPhDr4kwGk8ffem31WxP8=&emci=e8d459fb-7d14-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=fcc1c5e3-ec16-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=23786099)

| | **Political courage is a rarity these days. And I'm not just talking about Washington, Peter.** Our state, led by former Iowa Governor Bob Ray, a Republican, in the 1970s became the first in the nation to welcome refugees fleeing the Vietnam War. At the time, this was an incredibly unpopular move. In fact, Governor Ray had to request a _special exception_ from President Ford to accommodate the thousands of Tai Dam refugees who, in such large numbers, wouldn’t have ordinarily been allowed by the U.S. State Department to settle in one location. But Governor Ray saw people who needed help. And despite the political risk, he chose to welcome thousands of refugees, including my family, because he knew it was simply the right thing to do. **Peter, this is why I admire Bob Ray, and hope to model my leadership in Congress after folks like him. We need strong,_compassionate_ that understands the necessity of doing what is right — not what is politically expedient. ** [**If you’re ready to elect leaders who won’t hesitate to act when they see Iowans in need, please pitch in to my campaign for Congress today. Team — Earlier this year, the Senate passed the Radiation Exposure Compensation Reauthorization Act (RECA) which renews funding for residents of radiation-exposed communities, including the Navajo Nation right here in Arizona.
Between World War II and the Cold War, the lands of underserved communities like Navajo Nation and the Pueblo Nation in New Mexico were used for uranium mining and atomic weapons testing — leaving lasting harm on the communities and people that live there. Since 1990, RECA has provided financial support to the communities who were exposed to the toxic radiation from mining and testing.
But without a House vote, this support is set to run out, leaving victims of exposure at risk. Will you add your name right now to support the renewal of RECA? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/XtYtAsBZ1kWaxUz-UZZthQ2]

clean_body: [] ADD YOUR NAME: Pass the Radiation Exposure Compensation Act → ADD YOUR NAME [] Team — Earlier this year, the Senate passed the Radiation Exposure Compensation Reauthorization Act (RECA) which renews funding for residents of radiation-exposed communities, including the Navajo Nation right here in Arizona. Between World War II and the Cold War, the lands of underserved communities like Navajo Nation and the Pueblo Nation in New Mexico were used for uranium mining and atomic weapons testing — leaving lasting harm on the communities and people that live there. Since 1990, RECA has provided financial support to the communities who were exposed to the toxic radiation from mining and testing. But without a House vote, this support is set to run out, leaving victims of exposure at risk. Will you add your name right now to support the renewal of RECA? How many more high school graduations, elementary schools, houses of worship, outlet malls, and more must be marred by violence before we take more aggressive action on gun safety legislation? I want to be frank with you. **This doesn’t have to be our reality.** We can – and should – do more to prevent these tragedies. Our _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ was an important first step in addressing the gun violence epidemic, but there’s a lot more we can do. That’s why Senator Kaine and I introduced the _Virginia Plan to Reduce Gun Violence Act_ , legislation that would enact a series of gun violence prevention measures federally. **__[Will you sign my petition in support of this bill? Your voice is essential in demanding that Congress take action on gun safety.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85316819/474366565/-1123135811?refcode=mw_em_240520_1&ms=mw_em_240520_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OWMyYmYyYy1mMTE2LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7Oc32g3eHJK6QJgmAdvohunMVDpLWne9q40Ta3XsUfQ=&emci=ef6420db-e416-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=59c2bf2c-f116-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4568237)__** Our bill would limit the purchase of handguns, require gun owners to report lost or stolen firearms, prevent firearm access to minors, increase protections for victims of domestic violence by closing the “boyfriend loophole” – which currently allows abusive non-spousal partners to possess firearms – and establish a risk protection order to remove firearms from individuals who pose a high threat of harming themselves or others. Deadly mass shootings don’t have to be our reality, Derek. Americans want commonsense guardrails around gun ownership. Senator Kaine and I have a plan to put them in place. **__[Sign on now to tell Congress to pass the _Virginia Plan to Reduce Gun Violence Act_ >>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85316820/474366567/-1123135811?refcode=mw_em_240520_1&ms=mw_em_240520_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OWMyYmYyYy1mMTE2LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7Oc32g3eHJK6QJgmAdvohunMVDpLWne9q40Ta3XsUfQ=&emci=ef6420db-e416-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=59c2bf2c-f116-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4568237)__** Thank you for making your voice heard, Mark Warner ********[ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85316822/474366568/-1123135811?refcode=mw_em_240520_1&ms=mw_em_240520_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OWMyYmYyYy1mMTE2LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7Oc32g3eHJK6QJgmAdvohunMVDpLWne9q40Ta3XsUfQ=&emci=ef6420db-e416-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=59c2bf2c-f116-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4568237)********

I want to be frank with you. This doesn’t have to be our reality. We can – and should – do more to prevent these tragedies. Our Bipartisan Safer Communities Act was an important first step in addressing the gun violence epidemic, but there’s a lot more we can do. That’s why Senator Kaine and I introduced the Virginia Plan to Reduce Gun Violence Act , legislation that would enact a series of gun violence prevention measures federally. Our bill would limit the purchase of handguns, require gun owners to report lost or stolen firearms, prevent firearm access to minors, increase protections for victims of domestic violence by closing the “boyfriend loophole” – which currently allows abusive non-spousal partners to possess firearms – and establish a risk protection order to remove firearms from individuals who pose a high threat of harming themselves or others. Deadly mass shootings don’t have to be our reality, Derek. Americans want commonsense guardrails around gun ownership. Senator Kaine and I have a plan to put them in place. Thank you for making your voice heard, Mark Warner ********** | | Friends of Mark Warner 1490-5A Quarterpath Road #213 Williamsburg, VA 23185 United States | Click here to . | Paid for by Friends of Mark Warner

clean_body: Jamaal is one of the strongest progressives in Congress. | | | Friend, AIPAC is planning to spend $20 million against Jamaal Bowman in the next month. The anti-Palestinian group’s super PAC just spent $2 million for one week’s worth of attack ads targeting Jamaal, who has been an outspoken leader for Palestinians’ human rights. Jamaal joined me early on in demanding a permanent ceasefire. He recognizes that the U.S. government is complicit in genocide, and he’s working to stop it. With Jamaal’s re-election about a month away, MAGA Republican mega-donors are dropping millions to support his opponent through AIPAC. AIPAC recruited Jamaal’s anti-ceasefire opponent, and** has even encouraged Republicans to register as Democrats in order to vote for Jamaal’s opponent—carrying out a pattern of interfering in Democratic primaries to take down Black and brown progressives. | In 2022’s midterm elections, AIPAC and its network of PACs spent $40 million against Black and brown progressives, with most of the funds coming from Trump-supporting GOP mega-donors. AIPAC also endorsed more than 100 insurrectionist members of Congress who voted to overturn 2020’s election. These anti-democratic legislators are trying to censor discussions of racism in schools and ban diversity initiatives in public education. Meanwhile, Rep. Jamaal Bowman has introduced urgent legislation to support African American history education, and he’s bringing us closer to a multi-racial democracy where we all have equal rights protected by the government. For years, Jamaal has called to condition U.S. funding for Israel’s military based on Palestinians’ human rights. After visiting my grandmother in the West Bank, he compared Palestinians’ lives under Israeli military control to his experience with racist U.S. police targeting Black people like him. Jamaal and I understand that marginalized people’s struggles are intertwined, and we want to make our government work for all of us—not just the privileged few. Instead of voting to send billions of American taxpayer dollars to Israel’s apartheid regime, Jamaal is pushing to invest in our communities’ needs, like public education and utility services. Since he’s up against billionaires who’ll spend a lot to continue the unjust status quo, Jamaal needs support from our grassroots movement between now and his state’s June 25th Democratic primary election. From: Rick Larsen <campaign@ricklarsen.org>

Subject: That is billion, with a B.
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com
If someone asked me to describe this new law I am proposing, you could reasonably answer: this one is absolutely for the birds.
It is called The Migratory Birds of the Americas Conservation Enhancements Act. Here is how it works, why it matters, and why it has received bipartisan support out of committee on its way to the House floor.
**There are nearly three billion fewer birds than there were two generations ago. That is billion, with a B.**
Three billion anything is an astounding amount. So to say that we have lost that many birds over the last 50 years is worth stopping, taking a moment to think, and then asking: what can we do right now to help?
The answer is this law.
Across the United States, crisscrossing thousands of miles, migratory birds journey between part-time homes. Along the way are crucial stretches of land, and habitats for these birds, in urgent need of rehabilitation.

We’re committing $19 million in reservations for television advertisements through to Election Day. It’s the biggest advertising reservation of any Senate campaign in the country.
#

Peter —
A few days ago, we rolled out a major announcement.
We’re committing $19 million in reservations for television advertisements through to Election Day.
It’s the biggest advertising reservation of any Senate campaign in the country, and it’s a whole lot bigger than what Kari Lake has put up.
A couple notes on this buy: First, it’s what we need to do to win this race. Plain and simple. But second, it’s also a reflection of the strength of this campaign, and the faith we have in our donors — the people who have given, and the people who might chip in down the line.
If we stay on track and hit our fundraising goals week after week, month after month, we’ll be able to keep these reservations and add more. But if we fall off, if we miss our goals... we’re going to have to reel in our plans. And that will hurt our chances.
Now, the bad news is that we’ve had a rough month since we placed these reservations. We’ve got to turn that around, because we can’t afford to miss our goals.
The good news is we have a lot of time to get back on track before our May fundraising deadline hits on the 31st.
If everybody reading this right now chipped in $5, we’d absolutely crush our goal. We wouldn’t have to ask again for weeks. But that’s the big issue here — not everyone chips in.
And that’s why it’s so important that you do, Peter.

| Peter,

As a parent, I understand the challenges that families face when it comes to finding accessible and affordable childcare. **With almost 30% of North Carolina’s childcare programs expected to close this summer,** I know families would be devastated by fewer options, higher prices, and longer commutes to find the right childcare program.

I’m glad to have introduced the _Expanding Child Care Access Act_ with six other House members to address the growing issue of childcare availability and affordability for families.

## **_The New York Times_ , May 20, 2024: “2 Liberal Groups to Spend $5 Million on State Supreme Court Races”**
When the Supreme Court declared that it would not intervene to protect voters from partisan gerrymandering in the _Rucho_ case in 2019, and then later ripped away the constitutional right to safe and healthy abortions in the _Dobbs_ case in 2022, it became so much more clear that state courts are a critical line of defense to protect our rights, which we have to protect. **But ideologically charged state supreme courts have still issued dangerous rulings that further put our democracy and our reproductive rights in danger.** They’ve threatened our democracy with decisions that overturned fair maps like those in North Carolina or restricted voters’ ability to make their voices heard. And some courts have allowed draconian laws to take effect, winding the clock back decades on reproductive rights. These backwards decisions are the result of a continued effort by powerful special interests and out-of-touch politicians to install partisan justices who put ideology ahead of legal principle and precedent. **We have to fight back. But ideologically charged state supreme courts have still issued dangerous rulings that further put our democracy and our reproductive rights in danger. They’ve threatened our democracy with decisions that overturned fair maps like those in North Carolina or restricted voters’ ability to make their voices heard. And some courts have allowed draconian laws to take effect, winding the clock back decades on reproductive rights. These backwards decisions are the result of a continued effort by powerful special interests and out-of-touch politicians to install partisan justices who put ideology ahead of legal principle and precedent. We have to fight back. Hey Peter,
I had an extra few minutes this morning so I wanted to share some thoughts with you.
Here’s the truth:
No matter why you are reading this, I am thankful for you.
People like me don’t often make it to Congress.
I’m the son of Latino immigrants, who, with my three sisters, was raised by my single mother. I was the first in my family to attend college, cleaning the toilets of my classmates to make it work, and I joined the Marine Corps after graduating and went to Iraq.
The only reason I am here is because of the support I’ve had along the way.
As a kid, the support from my family.
In combat, the support of my fellow Marines.
In these campaigns, support from people like you.
But now I have a new mission: replacing Kyrsten Sinema and working to expand voting rights, protect abortion rights, take on drug companies and hedge fund managers and be a voice and a vote for working people in the Senate.

clean_body: The only reason I am here... = Hey Peter, I had an extra few minutes this morning so I wanted to share some thoughts with you. Here’s the truth: No matter why you are reading this, I am thankful for you. People like me don’t often make it to Congress. I’m the son of Latino immigrants, who, with my three sisters, was raised by my single mother. I was the first in my family to attend college, cleaning the toilets of my classmates to make it work, and I joined the Marine Corps after graduating and went to Iraq. The only reason I am here is because of the support I’ve had along the way. As a kid, the support from my family. In combat, the support of my fellow Marines. In these campaigns, support from people like you. But now I have a new mission: replacing Kyrsten Sinema and working to expand voting rights, protect abortion rights, take on drug companies and hedge fund managers and be a voice and a vote for working people in the Senate. body:
What comes next and what YOU can do to free Assange.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_petition_bump&n=1)
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=PQrdvvs0u40ZFQHVK0YXh2wFlbq35IP6LZ3vWJmnE42Nt9HMhLJwoV5RufU_aU3oPQGhhWgJZ3Hh9TBfC_R45rtN703VkleRxjWKjKOi-9c&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_petition_bump&n=2)
---
Peter – We received outstanding news this morning.

Two senior judges from the U.K.’s high court ruled that the assurances provided by the DOJ in their persecution of Julian Assange were not sufficient.

Specifically, the court concluded that Assange would face likely abuse and prolonged solitary confinement in the U.S. prison system if he is extradited and convicted.

**_All of this is excellent news, but it does not mean Assange is free.

_** Today’s ruling means that Assange can continue with a full appeal under the U.K. courts, but he remains incarcerated at Belmarsh for now.

The courts have sent a clear message that they do not believe Assange will receive justice in an American court. We are demanding President Biden drop this case and set Julian free. Will you join us?
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=PQrdvvs0u40ZFQHVK0YXh2wFlbq35IP6LZ3vWJmnE42Nt9HMhLJwoV5RufU_aU3oPQGhhWgJZ3Hh9TBfC_R45rtN703VkleRxjWKjKOi-9c&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_petition_bump&n=3 "Add My Name") [Add My Name](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=PQrdvvs0u40ZFQHVK0YXh2wFlbq35IP6LZ3vWJmnE42Nt9HMhLJwoV5RufU_aU3oPQGhhWgJZ3Hh9TBfC_R45rtN703VkleRxjWKjKOi-9c&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_petition_bump&n=3)
---
After signing, please forward this email with the original message below to three friends. Tell them why this case is important to you, and ask that they sign alongside you. Assange’s appeals are expected to go into next year. If Joe Biden refuses to drop the charges, the next president can. **As president, I will drop the case against Julian Assange on Day 1 in the White House and end our government’s war on press freedom.

[We are down to the wire on ballot access in New York, and more deadlines are ahead. Donate now to make sure our campaign can be on the ballot across the country this November.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_petition_bump&n=4)**

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill \---------- Forwarded message \--------- From: **Jill Stein** <info@jillstein2024.com>
Date: Sun, May 19, 2024
Subject: Julian Assange may be extradited in the next 24 hours
---
Peter,

The world’s foremost journalist and political prisoner, Julian Assange, is headed back to court in London tomorrow.

This is the final hearing to determine whether or not the United States has satisfied the “assurances” demanded by the U.K. high court that Assange would be permitted to use freedom of speech in his defense against charges of espionage, and that he would not face the death penalty if convicted.

If the high court is satisfied, his extradition will be approved and he could be on a plane within 24 hours.
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=PQrdvvs0u40ZFQHVK0YXh2wFlbq35IP6LZ3vWJmnE42Nt9HMhLJwoV5RufU_aU3oPQGhhWgJZ3Hh9TBfC_R45rtN703VkleRxjWKjKOi-9c&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_petition_bump&n=5 "Free Assange NOW") [Free Assange NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=PQrdvvs0u40ZFQHVK0YXh2wFlbq35IP6LZ3vWJmnE42Nt9HMhLJwoV5RufU_aU3oPQGhhWgJZ3Hh9TBfC_R45rtN703VkleRxjWKjKOi-9c&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_petition_bump&n=5)
---
There are three possible outcomes with tomorrow’s hearing according to a recent report from Reuters:

**Possibility #1: The high court rules in favor of extradition.
** In this case, Assange will have no further legal recourse in the U.K. However, his lawyers can and will immediately turn to the European Court of Human Rights to seek an emergency injunction blocking the extradition until a full hearing before THAT court.

**Possibility #2: The high court rules the U.S. “assurances” are not sufficient.
** In this case, Assange will have grounds to continue his appeal against extradition in cases that will extend into next year while he remains incarcerated at Belmarsh.

**Possibility #3: The high court throws out the case.
** This is the best possible outcome, because it will mean Julian could be immediately released.

But there is actually one further avenue.

Joe Biden could listen to the millions of Americans who believe, as I do, that Julian Assange is being persecuted for the crime of doing journalism – and drop the charges immediately.

We’ve been calling on the Biden administration to drop their case and set Julian free. Will you add your name now?
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=PQrdvvs0u40ZFQHVK0YXh2wFlbq35IP6LZ3vWJmnE42Nt9HMhLJwoV5RufU_aU3oPQGhhWgJZ3Hh9TBfC_R45rtN703VkleRxjWKjKOi-9c&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_petition_bump&n=6)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=PQrdvvs0u40ZFQHVK0YXh2wFlbq35IP6LZ3vWJmnE42Nt9HMhLJwoV5RufU_aU3oPQGhhWgJZ3Hh9TBfC_R45rtN703VkleRxjWKjKOi-9c&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_petition_bump&n=7 "Free Assange NOW") [Free Assange NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/r?u=PQrdvvs0u40ZFQHVK0YXh2wFlbq35IP6LZ3vWJmnE42Nt9HMhLJwoV5RufU_aU3oPQGhhWgJZ3Hh9TBfC_R45rtN703VkleRxjWKjKOi-9c&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=assange_petition_bump&n=7)
---
The United States government has outrageously charged Assange with violations of the _Espionage Act_ – an antiquated law that explicitly prohibits defendants from invoking their right to free expression as a defense. Unsurprisingly, it has been used almost exclusively to persecute whistleblowers, activists, and journalists like Julian Assange.

**Three American presidents – two Democrats and one Republican – have targeted Assange. We are calling on President Biden to end his part in this dark chapter today.

** We need a president committed to defending free expression, transparency, and accountability. If Biden won’t do it, _you can be assured that I will_.

As president, I will drop the case against Julian Assange on Day 1 in the White House. I will restore our nation’s commitment to a free press by ending the outrageous practice of targeting journalists and whistleblowers under the Espionage Act.

**I have advocated for Assange’s freedom for years, and I am the only candidate who will be on the ballot across the country in November who has called for dropping all charges in this case. I urge you to join me with a contribution to our campaign today.**

If Joe Biden refuses to drop the charges, the next president can. As president, I will drop the case against Julian Assange on Day 1 in the White House and end our government’s war on press freedom. In solidarity and gratitude, Jill \---------- Forwarded message \--------- From: Jill Stein <info@jillstein2024.com> Date: Sun, May 19, 2024 Subject: Julian Assange may be extradited in the next 24 hours Peter, The world’s foremost journalist and political prisoner, Julian Assange, is headed back to court in London tomorrow. This is the final hearing to determine whether or not the United States has satisfied the “assurances” demanded by the U.K. high court that Assange would be permitted to use freedom of speech in his defense against charges of espionage, and that he would not face the death penalty if convicted. If the high court is satisfied, his extradition will be approved and he could be on a plane within 24 hours. | "Free Assange NOW" There are three possible outcomes with tomorrow’s hearing according to a recent report from Reuters: Possibility #1: The high court rules in favor of extradition. In this case, Assange will have no further legal recourse in the U.K. However, his lawyers can and will immediately turn to the European Court of Human Rights to seek an emergency injunction blocking the extradition until a full hearing before THAT court. Possibility #2: The high court rules the U.S. “assurances” are not sufficient. In this case, Assange will have grounds to continue his appeal against extradition in cases that will extend into next year while he remains incarcerated at Belmarsh. Possibility #3: The high court throws out the case. This is the best possible outcome, because it will mean Julian could be immediately released. But there is actually one further avenue. Joe Biden could listen to the millions of Americans who believe, as I do, that Julian Assange is being persecuted for the crime of doing journalism – and drop the charges immediately. We’ve been calling on the Biden administration to drop their case and set Julian free. Will you add your name now? | "Free Assange NOW" The United States government has outrageously charged Assange with violations of the Espionage Act – an antiquated law that explicitly prohibits defendants from invoking their right to free expression as a defense. Unsurprisingly, it has been used almost exclusively to persecute whistleblowers, activists, and journalists like Julian Assange. Three American presidents – two Democrats and one Republican – have targeted Assange. We are calling on President Biden to end his part in this dark chapter today. We need a president committed to defending free expression, transparency, and accountability. If Biden won’t do it, you can be assured that I will. As president, I will drop the case against Julian Assange on Day 1 in the White House. I will restore our nation’s commitment to a free press by ending the outrageous practice of targeting journalists and whistleblowers under the Espionage Act. I have advocated for Assange’s freedom for years, and I am the only candidate who will be on the ballot across the country in November who has called for dropping all charges in this case. I urge you to join me with a contribution to our campaign today. | "DONATE NOW" In solidarity and gratitude, Jill | "Support Jill Today!" [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741uwl9pDp8g-rX1WnI3QBeNAx-fH6JOJZ8WLkW9b1cqKdznYHsxOz-dEB1dtrpi0DjOA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_statewide_call_remind&n=3) We are so happy to have Forward Party Co-Chair Lt. This will be one of the biggest announcements we've ever made and it's coming together quickly. It's also a great time to reach out to your personal representative and see if you can visit their office while you're in town.
* * *
### **We hope you can join us at our convention on June 1st**
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u2f82VcN49yJ3Wou-X6QZ0iX7Wo282dwEVAVW2OXhRwp9nFWgJUYIxm1C0IOL0s56czjj0_b1t4xvpmls2l_Pm8&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_statewide_call_remind&n=5)
One of the best days since the forming of the PA Forward Party was May 20, 2023 when we had our first PA Forward Summit. We took huge organizational steps and met many people in person for the first time.
Many things have changed since then. We've had affiliation events and even got our first Forwardist in office. We've had new supporters, volunteers, and leaders join our ranks.
Now, as we work towards what is by far, our most ambitious election season since we started, please join us to look to the future. We've sometimes been referred to as a group for the politically homeless. That won't feel true when you're with so many people working to build a place we can all call home.

1061 York Road

Why Yoopers and Northern Michiganders should support Bob Lorinser for Congress
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blairbob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blairbob]
Dr. Bob Lorinser is the ideal candidate to represent Michigan's First District in the U.S. Congress. As a lifelong Yooper and retired combat veteran, I have closely observed Dr. Lorinser's character and commitment, and he stands head and shoulders above the rest. Can you join me in supporting him tonight? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blairbob]
CONTRIBUTE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blairbob]
Friends,
First, a little about me: I was born and raised here, served in the military, saw combat in Afghanistan, and returned home after retiring from the Joint Staff.
I voted first mainly for Republicans and finally as a staunchly independent voter. I looked for candidates based on these criteria: wisdom, knowledge and experience, compassion, charisma and positivity, and, above all, integrity, which is the military's first Core Value.
It's hard to find a candidate who embodies them all, but Dr. Bob does. I first met him at a town hall meeting back in 2020. I critiqued everything he said, found the chance to speak with him afterward, and, over time, realized that he had met all of the above.
First and foremost, Dr. Lorinser has deep roots in our community, evident in his lifelong actions. He has lived here for over thirty years, serving as a dedicated physician for our families. Unlike other candidates who only claim to be from here or moved here just before running for office, Dr. Lorinser and his family are true Yoopers who understand our unique way of life and the challenges we face.
Second, Dr. Lorinser's campaign is fueled by grassroots support. He doesn't rely on large corporate donations or dark money. Instead, he humbly asks for our contributions, making us the primary funding source for his campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blairbob]
This ensures that he remains independent and accountable only to us, the residents of the First District.
As for all other candidates, scrutinize their backgrounds, including residency in our district, employment, and the
origins of their campaign contributions. I'm sure you'll see Dr. Bob is far above all others. I know he will make us proud as our representative in Congress. As a matter of fact, I guarantee it.
— Blair J. Anderson,
Master Sergeant, United States Air Force (Ret.)

Larry Hogan and I disagree on a lot of things, and here are 3 areas where we differ:
_I believe abortion should be safe, legal, and accessible for everyone, but Hogan disagrees._
**During his time as governor, he vetoed legislation to expand abortion access, and you’d better believe he’d support a national abortion ban. He was even so condescending as to belittle abortion as _“an emotional issue for women.”_**
_I believe that workers’ rights should be expanded, and unions given more power to collectively bargain, but Hogan disagrees._
**He vetoed a law that would have allowed workers to deduct union dues from state income taxes.**
_I believe that we can and should be doing more to improve the lives of working Marylanders, but again, Hogan disagrees._
**That’s why he vetoed a $15 minimum wage.**

| We’re being outspent by Republicans at every turn.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2646%2E35263%2E50u8jj)
Hi, Peter — I hope your week is off to a great start! In a moment, **[I’m going to ask you to make a donation to my reelection campaign.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-may24.HLGTSS&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240520_PM1_V2_S1&t=14&akid=2646%2E35263%2E50u8jj)** But first, I hope you’ll allow me to explain why your support is so important — _especially today._ This election is shaping up to be my most expensive and competitive one yet. My self-funding Republican opponent has already spent more than $6 million on advertising. A Mitch McConnell-aligned super PAC is planning $3 million worth of attack ads of their own. And on top of that, five more dark money groups have reserved a combined $2 million worth of ads attacking my campaign in Wisconsin. Peter, our campaign is being outspent by my Republican opponent and his dark money allies at every turn. You can’t turn on the TV without seeing an ad that uplifts my opponent or bashes my campaign with misleading attacks. If we let this continue, Eric Hovde will continue to surge in the polls and dominate the narrative in this Senate race. We need to turn the tides. **Earlier today, our campaign made a risky decision to do exactly that. We increased our May advertising budget so that we can set the record straight** — about my work in the U.S. Senate, about Eric Hovde and his far-right views, and about how detrimental a Republican Senate majority would be for our country. This was a tough call, though, because we don’t have enough funds in the budget to fully cover this ad buy. But I felt confident taking the risk because this grassroots team has always had my back. ---
| | Last [week](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=8a7e2509ccc94c32b0ede0250618192c&_e=U0QQChi6MtKeadwIQEE_jxxkaUlQrojfl5_KfAWiMYB-UYsgyLsMIsybwmnC1CivVCfFglw45Qd6nMwBySv76zYZ9SDWhnIG_aHijbo18VF6wMgF9ejfkxEcrDerTG-UtD-y2vcGIA5FKFhuuNlKHC5UBLKpWM2LgjHXYOO0LgLr2YtIps6W8ve7DPRuHIY2Sv_T75t-5-oOYwng2kDC3xhlfCd_1ewUaS7hKtC40Zl7EZPvbtyX84Z8kTuM-IXf5IHh4zb63YKkjqt8rFbNlg%3D%3D) Xi Jinping, the General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party - and China’s de facto dictator - played host to Vladimir Putin on his first overseas trip since the Russian president was “re-elected”. If you needed any further proof of the growing alignment of America’s adversaries, look no further than this meeting - a meeting of anything but equals. Russia’s pariah-dom is forcing it closer to China, on whom it is increasingly relying for support. Beijing gets all of the benefits, deciding the pace and extent of this “friendship without limits,” and using Moscow to tweak the tail of Europe more broadly, but increase pressure on the West via Ukraine. China wants America focused on Europe and Ukraine - why? The more we focus there, the less we can focus on the Indo-Pacific and China’s hegemonic ambitions. We need to walk and chew gum at the same time, supporting Europe and pushing back against China in Asia, and right now we have an administration that struggles to do either.

# FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Reader,**I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.

I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.

**But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. Joining the Sun costs as little as a penny a day. I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. Joining the Sun costs as little as a penny a day. I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts. | | | | Please join me in the fight to restore America's journalism. This is one mission that our country desperately needs. | | | Larry Kudlow Columnist for The New York Sun | | | | | Larry Kudlow Columnist for The New York Sun | | |

---
**CAMPAIGN UPDATES FOR MAY 20, 2024**
**In this week's 'Chuck Muth's Truths', another GOP Primary Recommendation for Flemming Larsen:** _"In Congressional District 1, my recommendation is Flemming Larsen._ _Larsen ran for the State Assembly in 2022 and lost by just 384 votes out of more than 20,000 votes cast. More impressively, that was in a district in which Democrats outnumbered Republicans by 5,557 active voters going into Election Day._ **_The man clearly did something right._** _In addition, Larsen has put together an extremely impressive campaign this cycle in which he’s selflessly included “down-ballot” Republican candidates for local and legislative offices at his events. He’s a team player helping to lift all GOP boats._ _Nothing against the other candidates, but if anyone has a real shot at sending incumbent Democrat Rep. Dina “I’m Not Happy” Titus packing, it’s Flemming Larsen."_ _-Chuck Muth, author of Conservative News Blog_ ___________________________________________________________________
**We're turning up the heat as we close in on the primary - we are three weeks away!** Have you registered to vote Republican? Click below to register. _**[REGISTER TO VOTE REPUBLICAN](https://contact.larsenfornevada.com/l/Bgp56XeTOWHuDL1xwwPvEQ/892wxMM9DvCxwXUDMTIUiz1A/OXKOIH0ABAPr69gVwFGM9g)**_ SPECIAL NOTE: Team Larsen has great things happening over the next couple of weeks! Please scroll down to "Upcoming Events" to find all the details...we'll see you there!
|

**KNOCKING ON DOORS - MAKING PERSONAL CONNECTIONS**
| Team Larsen continues to visit voters daily in the many precincts within CD1, gaining new friends and supporters along the way. We would love to have you join us out in the community. If you are interested in participating with Team Larsen in our grassroots, canvassing connections, please reach out to Bette Schanafelt at bette@larsen4nevada.com
---
|
---
**SIGNS & PROMOTING FLEMMING LARSEN**
Everyone wants a sign! We had over 50 new requests this last week alone! Campaign signs influence how we vote more than you might realize. Signs provide a sense of name recognition and convey a sense of viability and electability. Signs are an important part of this campaign, and we need donations to continue pursuing the marketing efforts we have already started. If you would like to contribute by displaying a yard sign, please contact Christina Davis at [christina@larsen4nevada.com](mailto:christina@larsen4nevada.com). If you would like to donate in support of our larger signs, please click here: [Donate Today!](https://contact.larsenfornevada.com/l/Bgp56XeTOWHuDL1xwwPvEQ/LSgXJkYAxJP9In3T9piLKQ/OXKOIH0ABAPr69gVwFGM9g)
|
---
**ENJOYED TIME WITH VOTERS AT TACO TUESDAY**
Many thanks to Senator Buck for inviting Team Larsen to Taco Tuesday at O'Callaghan Park in Henderson this past week.It was incredible meeting so many new voters and sharing delicious tacos with the community.
|
---
**BOULDER CITY REPUBLICAN WOMEN'S MONTHLY LUNCHEON**
| A heartfelt thank you to the Boulder City Republican Women’s Club for having Flemming Larsen as their keynote speaker. It was truly inspiring for Flemming to share his platform and plans to beat Dina Titus and serve as your next representative in Congress with such an engaged audience.
---
**CAMPAIGN RALLY WITH LT. GOVERNOR STAVROS ANTHONY** What an amazing turnout for our "Candidates in the Park" event this past Saturday! Thank you to the hundreds who came out to support Flemming in his congressional run. Special thanks to the Lt. Governor and all the sitting representatives and fellow candidates who joined us—all working together to make Nevada the best place to live. The In N Out burger truck was a hit, serving 400 delicious burgers!
|
---
**UPCOMING EVENTS**
On Tuesday, May 21, Flemming Larsen will be a guest speaker at the monthly luncheon for the Southern Hills Republican Women. Event starts at 11:30am, doors open at 10:45am. For reservations, email shrwreservations2020@gmail.com

clean_body: Even in merch, the difference between Trump and this team couldn’t be more clear. | | Folks, President Biden likes to share this lesson from his father: that you should always “say what you mean and mean what you say.” We love that message here at DNC Merch HQ because, in politics, our favorite way to say things is through merchandise. Let’s look at what Donald Trump is saying with his merch: he’s selling $99 self-glorifying NFTs, $400 sneakers, and is trying to profit off the Bible. We think that says a lot about his intentions -- that he’s running this campaign for himself and his billionaire backers. That’s not what we stand for. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85325205/474381809/1433120897?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMjkzNGE0Zi0wNDE3LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rJI8psq81iy6BQ2Yy5OlCgZkHpPpKp2WY_ADuGr-jPY=) I’ve worn a lot of different hats throughout my life: advocate for children, state senator and now candidate for Congress. **But the best job I have is being a mom. My husband Joseph and I are the proud parents of six wonderful children.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85325206/474381810/480327972?refcode=email_052024_Mom-of-6-intro&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMjkzNGE0Zi0wNDE3LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rJI8psq81iy6BQ2Yy5OlCgZkHpPpKp2WY_ADuGr-jPY=) What I want for my family, what I spend my life fighting for, is what I want for every family: the Michigan Dream. I want all of our kids to be able to receive a quality education, grow up and get a good job, own a home, and not worry about how they’re going to pay the bills. Raising kids today isn’t easy – childcare is impossible to find and the costs of everyday items like groceries and housing are too expensive. For too many families across our state, the Michigan Dream is falling out of reach. **I’m running for Congress because, frankly, we need more level-headed people in Congress who focus on what families face every day. We need leaders who will work together to get real things done – and trust me, running a household with 6 kids, you learn a lot about negotiation, compromise, and toughness. I am ready to get things done.** But I need your support. This race for Congress will be one of the most competitive in the country, and we have less than 6 months left until Election Day. I’m counting on supporters like you to chip in so we can hire staff, run ads and talk to voters across Michigan’s 8th District.
